api.notes: Host semantics through ElementInternals: p is a paragraph, h1-h3 headings; span/div/label add no role.
`boolean | placement` becomes `no-truncate-tooltip` (true upstream default, A§7.2 inversion) plus `truncate-tooltip-placement`.
Attribute `has-capsize`; text-box trim is a progressive enhancement [mwg:precise-text-alignment].

api.reason: The global `id` attribute on the host is native; it is not component API.
A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(text), and the type/size/colour attributes.

differences.text: `hasTruncateTooltip` (boolean or placement, default true) is the boolean `no-truncate-tooltip` plus `truncate-tooltip-placement` (A§7.2 inversion of a true default).

`as` sets host semantics through ElementInternals (paragraph, heading level 1-3) instead of choosing the rendered element. `label` adds no role and cannot label a control across the shadow boundary; use tct-field.

The Tecton variants without a built-in type are registered as types: medium-strong, small-strong, tiny, large-data, medium-data, small-data, action-medium, action-small (owner's theme customTextTypes), bound to the type-scale tokens. The data types use `--tecton-font-numeric` (provisional).
A custom `type` or `color` is a plain string styled through `tct-text[type="x"]::part(text)`; there is no module augmentation or theme build step. Unknown values keep the body/primary baseline.

The truncation tooltip is described by its trigger inside one shadow root, opens on hover and tap, closes with Escape and never takes focus; the clipped text stays fully readable by assistive technology.

core.text.notes: Guides: [mwg:improve-text-layout-and-legibility] text-wrap balance/pretty are progressive enhancements; [mwg:precise-text-alignment] text-box trim; [mwg:accessible-web-components] role and level via ElementInternals; [mwg:interest-triggered-tooltips] and [mwg:position-aware-tooltips] the built-in tooltip (popover=manual through TooltipController, no interestfor because Safari lacks it); [mwg:css] cascade layers and logical properties.
